scope.title: Preflight consistency
scope.boundary: Actual preflight function and CLI with real private Git repositories; public remote state is unavailable or represented by a local bare remote. No pack/build/smoke/publication proof.

initial_state: Fresh v0.3.5 prepared release. Snapshot all relative file paths and bytes. Initialize local Git only for variants that claim Git discovery or tag behavior.

cases.title: Preflight remains repeatable, cheap and free of release mutations

conditions: Use a coherent prepared tree and snapshot artifacts. Observe actual subprocess/provider boundaries without replacing preflight itself.

when: Run preflight twice with identical inputs and no requested timing/log output.
then: Both calls agree and preserve every artifact byte.
No credentials, pack/build/archive generation, broad tests, public smoke or publication operation is invoked.

gaps: Preflight never invokes expensive qualification or publication: Existing idempotence tests inspect files and a returned tuple; add command-boundary observation without mocking preflight itself.

cases.title: Actual CLI discovery checks the changed files or reports discovery failure
cases.risk: The public command bypasses changed-file detection.

conditions: Use a real private Git tree and an unauthorized version literal in a changed file; also exercise explicit changed paths and unavailable Git discovery.

when: Run the real preflight CLI against clean and changed trees, then with missing discovery.
then: Clean input succeeds; both explicit and Git-discovered unauthorized literals fail with file/literal/owner guidance.
Failed change discovery is an error and cannot be represented as an empty clean change set.

cases.title: Preflight rejects an incoherent prepared release
cases.risk: A specific local inconsistency escapes cheap preflight and is discovered only after expensive qualification.

conditions: Start from a valid prepared tree and mutate exactly one prerequisite per run.

when: Run preflight after removing/corrupting the profile or required validation/metadata input, mismatching package version or metadata pointer, claiming published target smoke, or leaving release-output debris.
then: Every mutation produces its attributable prerequisite/consistency diagnostic before expensive qualification; a valid tree passes.
Preflight leaves all release artifacts unchanged.

cases.title: Tag observations distinguish a conflict from unavailable remote state
cases.risk: Tag lookup misses an immutable name collision.

conditions: Use private local/bare Git repositories for local and remote tags; use a controlled unavailable remote separately.

when: Run preflight with a conflicting local tag, reachable conflicting remote tag and unreachable remote.
then: Known conflicts block with their source identified; an unavailable remote is explicitly unknown and supplies no clean-public-state assertion.
Any explicitly allowed local conflict still names its required owner decision.
